europe_now.title: Security Incident at German Airport
europe_now.summary: A drone carrying explosives and a bomb-disposal robot were discovered at Leipzig airport. Authorities are investigating whether Russia is involved in the incident.

sources.headline: German airport drone-bomb: Could Russia be involved?

europe_now.title: Extreme Heat Impacting European Economy
europe_now.summary: Severe heatwaves are projected to cause an €800bn deficit in the European economy. Major impacts are expected in Germany, France, and Italy.

sources.headline: Italy places all major cities on red alert as heatwave grips Europe

top_stories.summary: EU ministers have left several board seats vacant on the Global Gateway. Meanwhile, migration officials state the EU cannot rely on neighbors for border control.
